source.chapter: 24 (effects of the lords of the houses)
source.note: Classical meanings restated in plain words for this app. Check against a verified edition before relying on them.

condition: The lord of house `lord_of` (counted from the Lagna) occupies house `placed_in` (whole-sign).

rules.text: With the Lagna lord in the Lagna you are self-reliant, healthy and strong-willed, and you make your own way in life.
With the Lagna lord in the 2nd you gain wealth through your own efforts, value your family and speak with conviction.
With the Lagna lord in the 3rd you are courageous and enterprising, and siblings and friends play a big part in your life.
With the Lagna lord in the 4th you enjoy the comforts of home, property and vehicles and share a close bond with your mother.
With the Lagna lord in the 5th you are intelligent and creative, and you find happiness through children and good counsel.
With the Lagna lord in the 6th you are a fighter who overcomes rivals, though health and debts need regular attention.
With the Lagna lord in the 7th your life revolves around partnership; the spouse and close associates shape your path.
With the Lagna lord in the 8th you are drawn to research and hidden matters; life brings transformations that call for resilience.
With the Lagna lord in the 9th you are fortunate, principled and devoted, and you benefit from teachers and your father.
With the Lagna lord in the 10th you are ambitious and respected, and you rise through your own work.
With the Lagna lord in the 11th you gain steadily, enjoy many friends and see your wishes fulfilled.
With the Lagna lord in the 12th you are generous and spiritually minded, but must guard your health, energy and expenses.
The 2nd lord in the Lagna lets you earn through your own personality and gives a strong attachment to family.
The 2nd lord in its own house brings steady wealth, good speech and a stable family life.
The 2nd lord in the 3rd brings income through communication, travel or the help of siblings; speech can be blunt.
The 2nd lord in the 4th brings wealth through property, vehicles and the mother's side, and a comfortable home.
The 2nd lord in the 5th brings money through intelligence, investments and children, and a lasting interest in learning.
The 2nd lord in the 6th brings income through service or competition but also debts; spend carefully.
The 2nd lord in the 7th brings gains through the spouse, partnerships and business.
The 2nd lord in the 8th makes finances fluctuate, with sudden gains or losses and possible inheritance; save carefully.
The 2nd lord in the 9th brings wealth through good fortune, the father or righteous work.
The 2nd lord in the 10th brings wealth through career and status, often with the family's support.
The 2nd lord in the 11th is excellent for income and savings, with gains from many sources.
The 2nd lord in the 12th makes expenses high, often on family, travel or charity; plan your savings.
The 3rd lord in the Lagna makes you bold, self-made and expressive, with talent in communication.
The 3rd lord in the 2nd brings income through communication, writing or trade; take care with your words.
The 3rd lord in its own house gives courage, supportive siblings and success through effort.
The 3rd lord in the 4th brings comforts at home through your own efforts and short trips for property or study.
The 3rd lord in the 5th gives creative intelligence and talent in writing, music or the arts.
The 3rd lord in the 6th gives the courage to defeat rivals, though relations with siblings may be strained.
The 3rd lord in the 7th brings travel connected with partnerships and an active, communicative spouse.
The 3rd lord in the 8th asks for care in risky ventures and for the welfare of siblings.
The 3rd lord in the 9th brings fortune through travel, writing and siblings, and broad-minded beliefs.
The 3rd lord in the 10th favours a career in communication, media, travel or skilled work.
The 3rd lord in the 11th brings gains through siblings, friends, networking and courage.
The 3rd lord in the 12th points to travel abroad or expenses on siblings; direct your efforts wisely.
The 4th lord in the Lagna gives a happy disposition, learning and a comfortable home.
The 4th lord in the 2nd brings wealth through property and family, and a pleasant home life.
The 4th lord in the 3rd brings changes of residence and comforts gained through your own courage.
The 4th lord in its own house gives a peaceful home, vehicles, education and a caring mother.
The 4th lord in the 5th gives good education, happiness from children and a devotional mind.
The 4th lord in the 6th may disturb domestic peace or bring disputes over property; patience helps.
The 4th lord in the 7th brings a home-loving spouse and property through marriage or partnership.
The 4th lord in the 8th may bring worries about the mother, home or property; an inheritance is possible.
The 4th lord in the 9th is fortunate for property, higher education and a happy life.
The 4th lord in the 10th brings career success connected with property, vehicles, education or the public.
The 4th lord in the 11th brings gains from property and vehicles and the comforts you wish for.
The 4th lord in the 12th may take you away from your birthplace; living abroad or spending on a home is possible.
The 5th lord in the Lagna gives intelligence, good judgement and joy from children.
The 5th lord in the 2nd brings wealth through intelligence and learning, and a cultured family.
The 5th lord in the 3rd gives talent in writing, speaking and the arts; children may be few but capable.
The 5th lord in the 4th gives a happy home, a good education and a devoted, contented mind.
The 5th lord in its own house gives sharp intelligence, good children and merit from past deeds.
The 5th lord in the 6th may bring worries about children or studies; perseverance brings results.
The 5th lord in the 7th brings an intelligent, cultured spouse and love that leads to partnership.
The 5th lord in the 8th turns the mind to research and mysticism; matters of children need care.
The 5th lord in the 9th is very fortunate: wisdom, devotion, good children and support from teachers.
The 5th lord in the 10th brings a respected career that uses intelligence, advice or teaching.
The 5th lord in the 11th brings gains through intelligence, investments and children.
The 5th lord in the 12th gives spiritual inclinations; children may live far away.
The 6th lord in the Lagna gives a competitive nature; health needs regular care and conflicts are best avoided.
The 6th lord in the 2nd may bring family disputes or debts; careful speech and budgeting help.
The 6th lord in the 3rd gives courage against opponents, though relations with siblings need care.
The 6th lord in the 4th may disturb peace at home or bring property disputes.
The 6th lord in the 5th asks for care with studies, speculation and children's health.
The 6th lord in its own house helps you defeat enemies and overcome disease and debt.
The 6th lord in the 7th may bring disagreements in marriage or partnerships; patience is essential.
The 6th lord in the 8th weakens enemies and illness (a Viparita influence), though health still needs watching.
The 6th lord in the 9th may bring differences with elders or teachers; keep your faith practical.
The 6th lord in the 10th brings success in service, law, medicine or competitive careers, along with rivals at work.
The 6th lord in the 11th brings gains through service and competition, but friends may turn into rivals.
The 6th lord in the 12th breaks the strength of enemies (a Viparita influence) while asking for care with expenses.
The 7th lord in the Lagna brings an influential spouse and a life shaped by partnerships.
The 7th lord in the 2nd brings wealth through marriage or business partnership.
The 7th lord in the 3rd brings a spouse connected with travel or communication; siblings may join in partnerships.
The 7th lord in the 4th brings a home-loving spouse and happiness at home after marriage.
The 7th lord in the 5th brings a loving, intelligent spouse and possibly a love marriage.
The 7th lord in the 6th may bring disagreements or delays in marriage; understanding is needed.
The 7th lord in its own house gives a good spouse, a stable marriage and success in partnership.
The 7th lord in the 8th asks for patience in married life and care for the spouse's health.
The 7th lord in the 9th brings a fortunate, principled spouse and good fortune after marriage.
The 7th lord in the 10th brings a career-minded spouse or success in business partnerships.
The 7th lord in the 11th brings gains through the spouse and partnerships, and fulfilment of wishes.
The 7th lord in the 12th may bring a spouse from a distant place, or expenses connected with marriage.
The 8th lord in the Lagna asks for care with health and gives an interest in hidden subjects.
The 8th lord in the 2nd makes family finances fluctuate; watch your speech and diet.
The 8th lord in the 3rd gives long life but asks for caution in risky ventures.
The 8th lord in the 4th may disturb peace at home or the mother's health; property matters need care.
The 8th lord in the 5th asks for care with children and speculation; the mind turns to research.
The 8th lord in the 6th weakens opponents and illness (a Viparita influence).
The 8th lord in the 7th asks for patience in married life and care for the spouse's health.
The 8th lord in its own house gives long life and an interest in deep or occult studies.
The 8th lord in the 9th may bring differences with the father or delays in fortune.
The 8th lord in the 10th brings changes or obstacles in career; research or investigative work suits you.
The 8th lord in the 11th can bring sudden or unexpected gains, including inheritance.
The 8th lord in the 12th reduces misfortune (a Viparita influence) but brings expenses; spiritual practice helps.
The 9th lord in the Lagna makes you fortunate, principled and respected, and blessed by elders.
The 9th lord in the 2nd brings wealth through good fortune and a respected family.
The 9th lord in the 3rd brings fortune through effort, travel and siblings.
The 9th lord in the 4th brings property, vehicles and happiness from the mother and home.
The 9th lord in the 5th gives devotion, wisdom and fortunate children.
The 9th lord in the 6th may bring obstacles to fortune or differences with elders; service brings results.
The 9th lord in the 7th brings fortune after marriage and a virtuous spouse.
The 9th lord in the 8th may delay fortune; inheritance or research brings gains.
The 9th lord in its own house is highly fortunate: faith, wealth and support from the father.
The 9th lord in the 10th gives an honoured career and joins fortune with action (a Dharma–Karma link).
The 9th lord in the 11th brings abundant gains and fulfilled hopes.
The 9th lord in the 12th brings fortune through foreign lands, pilgrimage and charity.
The 10th lord in the Lagna makes you hard-working and self-made, and well known for your work.
The 10th lord in the 2nd brings wealth through career, often in a family business or finance.
The 10th lord in the 3rd favours a career in communication, travel, media or skilled trades.
The 10th lord in the 4th brings career success connected with property, education or the public, and a stable home.
The 10th lord in the 5th favours a career that uses intelligence, such as teaching, advising or creative work.
The 10th lord in the 6th brings success in service, health, law or competitive work, along with rivals.
The 10th lord in the 7th favours business, partnerships or work involving the public and travel.
The 10th lord in the 8th brings changes in career and success in research, insurance or investigation.
The 10th lord in the 9th brings a fortunate, ethical career and support from mentors.
The 10th lord in its own house gives a strong career, authority and recognition.
The 10th lord in the 11th brings good income from work and influential friends.
The 10th lord in the 12th brings work abroad or behind the scenes; expenses rise with career moves.
The 11th lord in the Lagna brings gains through your own personality and many supportive friends.
The 11th lord in the 2nd brings good earnings and savings, along with family wealth.
The 11th lord in the 3rd brings gains through siblings, communication and enterprise.
The 11th lord in the 4th brings gains through property, vehicles and the home.
The 11th lord in the 5th brings gains through intelligence, investments and children.
The 11th lord in the 6th brings gains through service or competition, but also debts or rivals among friends.
The 11th lord in the 7th brings gains through the spouse and business partnerships.
The 11th lord in the 8th makes income irregular, with sudden gains and losses.
The 11th lord in the 9th brings gains through good fortune, the father and long journeys.
The 11th lord in the 10th brings strong income from your career and recognition.
The 11th lord in its own house brings steady gains and fulfilment of desires.
The 11th lord in the 12th means gains are easily spent; save deliberately.
The 12th lord in the Lagna gives a generous, spiritual nature but also a tendency to overspend.
The 12th lord in the 2nd brings expenses on family; savings need discipline.
The 12th lord in the 3rd brings expenses on travel and siblings; effort may sometimes go unrewarded.
The 12th lord in the 4th may bring a home away from your birthplace or expenses on property.
The 12th lord in the 5th brings expenses on children or education, and a spiritual mind.
The 12th lord in the 6th weakens enemies and debts (a Viparita influence).
The 12th lord in the 7th brings expenses through marriage or partnerships; a spouse from afar is possible.
The 12th lord in the 8th reduces losses (a Viparita influence) and gives an interest in spiritual research.
The 12th lord in the 9th brings pilgrimage, foreign travel and spending on righteous causes.
The 12th lord in the 10th brings work connected with foreign lands, hospitals or large institutions.
The 12th lord in the 11th means gains and expenses balance each other; avoid lending money.
The 12th lord in its own house gives spending on good causes, restful sleep and spiritual progress.
